points.description: Identifies missing information about the vinegar: the volume/amount of vinegar poured into each container (and/or type, brand or concentration/acidity of the vinegar).

Identifies missing information about the samples: size, shape, or surface area of each sample, or the specific type/identity of the materials (e.g. what kind of wood or plastic), or that the samples were of comparable size.

Identifies another missing detail: type/size of container, temperature or location where samples were kept, how the mass was measured (balance/instrument and precision), how long to dry/rinse (volume of distilled water), or whether containers were covered.

rubric.notes: One mark for each distinct, valid piece of missing information, up to 3. Equivalent wording accepted. Do not award repeated points that are the same idea (e.g. vinegar amount and vinegar volume). Steps already stated in the procedure (24 hours, 30 minutes drying) do not earn marks.
